component.name: Avatar
component.description: Circular user avatar with image or initials fallback.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Avatar to represent a pet in Header MVP
antiPatterns.reason: Header MVP only supports user avatar.
antiPatterns.alternative: Add a dedicated PetAvatar component when product scope requires it.
